native_forecast.method: Round native total prediction minus the minute-rounded pause-list remainder to the nearest elapsed minute.
native_forecast.estimate_resolution: Native progress, remainder and countdown are minute-rounded estimates. The initial emitted countdown is about 4 hours 52 minutes; the total-minus-remainder method gives about 4 hours 54 minutes. Neither establishes an exact pause time. Heating, calibration, transfer and physical printing can shift the actual event.

scope: Programmed RC62 insertion boundary and approximate native start-to-pause forecast only. Attribution to a printer task requires the separately observed matching new acceptance. No printer command, geometry edit or archive replacement was performed.
estimate_scope: Approximate native forecast from observed acceptance; startup heating and calibration can shift the actual programmed pause. User action requires an observed matching pause, not the clock estimate.
